Queensboro Bridge bagels and lox.d: Toasted bagels, cream cheese whipped light, sliced Nova, capers, paper-thin red onion and dill.

Elaine's crostini.d: Crisp baguette rounds. Whipped ricotta with lemon zest and honey, or mushrooms fried with thyme and garlic under shaved parmesan.
Elaine's crostini.note: Passed on trays at cocktail hour.

Chinese takeaway in bed.d: Thigh meat tossed in a hot wok with dried red chilies and Szechuan peppercorns, glazed with black vinegar, soy and rice wine. Roasted peanuts, scallions and steamed rice.
Chinese takeaway in bed.note: Good in front of the late movie.

Worth-living-for cheesecake.d: Dense and creamy, lemon and vanilla, on a buttery crumb crust. Baked low, chilled overnight.
Worth-living-for cheesecake.note: Worth living for, say our regulars.

Manhattan cocktail.d: Rye, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred over ice, poured into chilled coupes with a cherry.
